personality_one_liner: A highly functional, official-feeling institutional app that pairs clean corporate navy aesthetics with structural rigor and transparent statuses.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for an uncluttered corporate feel. Cards use at least md/lg margins. Avoid dense, edge-to-edge grids unless specifically requested.

screens.name: Role Selection & Login
screens.purpose: Secure authentication gate with segmented role selection.

states.error: Inline text below input or bottom sheet for auth failures

screens.layout: Top third: University Logo + Welcome text. Middle: Segmented control (Student, Warden, Admin) followed by Email/RegNo & Password inputs. Bottom: Sticky primary CTA. Uses glass header if scrollable.

screens.name: Student Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central hub for a student to view their room info, roommates, and recent requests.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for hero card and recent requests list
states.error: Retry state replacing the failed section

screens.layout: Hero Section: 'surfaceSecondary' card overlaid with dark gradient scrim and 'modern dorm room' image showing block/room details. Quick Actions Grid: 2-column rounded cards for Cleaning, Maintenance, Leaves. List Section: 'Recent Requests' showing pill-shaped status badges.

screens.name: Warden Dashboard
screens.purpose: Operational command center for wardens to manage block metrics and pending tasks.

states.error: Retry button for fetching block data

screens.layout: Top: Summary metrics (Occupancy %, Pending Complaints). Quick Actions: 'Mark Attendance', 'Approve Leaves'. Bottom: Scrollable list of actionable threads/complaints needing attention.

screens.name: Maintenance/Cleaning Request Flow
screens.purpose: A streamlined form to submit requests with priority levels and photo attachments.

states.error: Error toast or inline validation messages

screens.layout: Single column form. Category selector (chips). Text area. Photo upload area (dashed border). Sticky CTA 'Submit Request' at the bottom within KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Attendance Roll Call (Warden)
screens.purpose: Fast, bulk-actionable list to mark student attendance daily.

states.error: Retry state for fetching student list

screens.layout: Top: Date picker and search bar. List of students with initials avatars. Each row has a segmented control (Present/Absent/Leave). Bottom: Sticky 'Mark All Present' floating glass button.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user explicitly requested a 'Navy/deep-blue' corporate banking-style UI. This overrides the default NO BLUE rule. Use the navy brand colors specified in the palette.
Implement '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. Keep typography highly legible using Plus Jakarta Sans. Spacing must be generous (lg/xl margins).
Use Phosphor icons. Ensure consistent weights across the app (fill for active tabs, regular for outlines).

Status badges (Pending, In Progress, Resolved) must use consistent color-coding (warning, info, success tokens) and be shaped as pills (radius: pill). Do not use chips for statuses; chips are for filtering.
For the Attendance Roll Call screen, utilize a list layout with a sticky bottom action (e.g., 'Mark All Present') inside a fixed glass container.
Always apply a gradient scrim over the 'dorm_hero' image before overlaying any text, ensuring WCAG contrast compliance.
Add 'haptics' on success states (e.g., form submissions, marking attendance).
